_comment: Issue #58: Tab-primed field-hotbar selection loop. Same title-Continue opening as field_skills_loop (near_tactician fixture: warrior L1 at the inn, [Basic Cleaning] innate, 1-slot bar). Proves: the bar renders (slots:1); Tab primes the keyboard cursor onto slot 0 (a ui_field_hotbar_selection_rendered event, index 0, label "[Basic Cleaning]"); move_right on a 1-slot bar wraps to itself (a FRESH selection event, still index 0) and the player's cell is provably unchanged -- arrows never reach Game.sim.move_player while primed; Esc disarms (selection event index -1, both skill/label empty); Tab re-primes (proves disarm didn't wedge the seam); confirm on the faced dirty_table fires the EXACT SAME stream field_skills_loop's number-key press does (skill_used{basic_cleaning,dirty_table} + cleaned_the_inn + toast) -- the number-key-equivalence exit criterion -- and activation's own one-shot disarm is proven by the trailing index:-1 selection event.

steps._comment: Bar renders 1 innate slot, same as field_skills_loop's own opening proof.

Face dirty_table (5,4): right3 -> (5,3), down1 blocks on the table & faces it -- same route field_skills_loop's number-key press uses, so the confirm-fired stream at the end of this script is directly comparable.
== TAB PRIMES == a non-empty bar with the cursor resting (-1): the cursor lands on slot 0 and the selection event fires with the real skill id + its (already-bracketed) display_name as the label.
steps.name: hotbar_prime

steps._comment: == move_right ON A 1-SLOT BAR WRAPS TO ITSELF, and arrows never reach Game.sim.move_player while primed == a fresh selection-rendered event fires (set_selected always redraws, even onto the same index) and the player's cell is provably unchanged from the assert just above.
steps.name: move_right

steps._comment: == Esc DISARMS == selection event fires with index -1 and both skill/label empty; the floating label is gone.
steps.name: cancel

steps._comment: == Tab RE-PRIMES == identical to the first prime -- proves disarm left the seam in a clean, re-armable state.
steps.name: hotbar_prime

steps._comment: == CONFIRM fires the primed slot on the faced dirty_table -- byte-identical stream to field_skills_loop's hotbar_1 press (same skill, same target, same toast, same accomplishment). The number-key-equivalence exit criterion.
steps.name: confirm

steps._comment: Activation is one-shot: confirm's own branch calls use_skill_field then disarms SYNCHRONOUSLY, before the toast panel's own queued/drained ui_toast_rendered confirmation fires -- this selection event lands chronologically BEFORE the ui_toast_rendered wait below, not after.

== REVIEW-FINDING GUARD: a primed cursor must DISARM when a conversation (or combat) opens -- an armed index surviving into a bar-hidden context locks the pause menu (field_slot_armed guard) while _movement_gated keeps the cancel branch unreachable. Route: (5,3) right2 -> (7,3), up1 blocks on Erin (7,2) & faces her ((5,2) is blocked, so the around-the-table leg won't do).
First interact absorbs Erin's rotating talk-pool bark (dialogue_line, NOT a conversation) -- the bar does not hide for barks and the cursor rightly stays armed through it.
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: The DIALOGUE_STARTED disarm: index -1 selection event fires as the conversation opens -- the pause-lockout regression's canonical tripwire.
